Had an excellent experience at Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital and Research Centre during my father’s bypass surgery treatment. Special thanks to Dr. Neeraj Kamat and his entire team for their exceptional treatment, guidance, and compassionate care throughout the journey. Their professionalism and support gave our family great confidence during a difficult time.

A heartfelt appreciation to the nursing staff, especially Nancy Dsouza, Akash, Nikita, and Deepali, for being extremely supportive, attentive, and caring at every step. Their kindness and dedication provided great comfort during the hospital stay.

Special thanks as well to the cleaning staff, especially Pawan Kumar and Barsa, for maintaining excellent hygiene and cleanliness and for their prompt support whenever needed.

One area where improvement is needed is visitor management and security coordination. The hospital has multiple levels of security checks — at the entrance, ground floor lift lobby, inside the lift area, and again on the patient floor. While security and patient safety are important, the process currently feels too strict and time-consuming for visitors. Visitor timings are already limited, and due to repeated checks and delays, a significant part of the allowed visiting time gets consumed. The hospital management may consider streamlining the process to make the visitor experience smoother while still maintaining safety standards.

Overall, highly thankful to the entire hospital team for their outstanding service and patient care.

Thanks,
From Bed No -1713

featured_reviews.review_text:
Saifee Hospital is a Dawoodi Bohra founded multi-speciality hospital at Charni Road, Mumbai, India, overlooking the Arabian Sea. Saifee Hospital is founded by the head of the Dawoodi Bohra faith, Syedna Mohammad Burhanuddin, dedicated the hospital to the memory of his revered father, Syedna Taher Saifuddin.
History:-
Saifee Hospital was established by the Dawoodi Bohras in 1948 with the aim of providing safe, ethical and affordable medical assistance to people of all faiths and socio-economic backgrounds. In 2000, the foundation of a new hospital on the existing premises was laid down by Dr Syedna Mohammed Burhanuddin. Construction commenced in 2001 and the new hospital was commissioned on 4 June 2005 in the presence of the Prime minister of India, Dr. Manmohan Singh. The architecture of the hospital features a combination of classical Arabian (with domes and arches) and contemporary (with glass curtain facades) styles.
Services:-
The hospital has approximately 257 beds, as well as 44 ICU beds, and 9 operating theaters, and conducts over 10,000 surgeries a year.
Saifee Hospital specializes in bariatric surgeries, cardiology, critical care medicine, dentistry, dermatology, gynecology, hepatology, oncology, neurology, nephrology, ophthalmology, neonatology, high dose radioactive therapy units, and Pressurized Intra Peritoneal Aerosol Chemotherapy (PIPAC). The hospital features a highly advanced Robotic Surgical System to facilitate the surgeon in performing complex but minimally invasive surgery.
In the aftermath of the 2011 Mumbai bombings, Saifee Hospital provided free treatment to victims and others affected by the bomb blast.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Abdul Raouf
featured_reviews.review_text:
Grant Medical College, established in 1845, is one of the oldest and most premier medical institutions in South Asia. It is consistently ranked among the top 10 medical colleges in India. Attached to the massive Sir J.J. Group of Hospitals, it serves as a tertiary care referral center for the entire state of Maharashtra.
The Strengths (Pros)
* Unmatched Clinical Exposure: This is the college's biggest selling point. The associated J.J. Hospital has a massive patient inflow (thousands of outpatients daily). As a student, you will see rare cases and common diseases in abundance. By the time you finish your internship, your clinical skills will be far superior to students from most other colleges.
* Top-Tier Faculty: The professors are often leaders in their respective fields. Being a government college in Mumbai, it attracts the best medical teachers.
* Affordability: Being a state government college, the fee structure is heavily subsidized and very affordable compared to private institutions.
* Location: Located in Byculla (South Mumbai), the campus is in the heart of the city. It is well-connected by local trains (Byculla station is walking distance) and offers access to the best of Mumbai.
* Prestige & Alumni Network: Graduating from "Grant" carries significant weight in the medical community, both in India and abroad (US/UK). The alumni network is vast and powerful.
The Challenges (Cons)
* Infrastructure & Maintenance: While the campus has beautiful heritage buildings, some facilities are aging. Lecture halls and labs are functional but may not be as modern or "glossy" as high-end private colleges.
* Hostel Conditions: This is a common complaint. Hostels can be crowded, and hygiene maintenance in the washrooms sometimes lags. Many students opt to live in PGs nearby after the first year, though this is expensive in South Mumbai.
* High Workload: The environment is high-pressure. Due to the massive patient load, internships and residency can be grueling with very long hours.
Campus Life
* Vibrant Atmosphere: The campus is huge (44 acres). It has a unique mix of medical students, nursing students, and physiotherapy students.
* Events: The annual cultural festival, "Astitva," and the sports meet, "Kurukshetra," are very popular and provide a much-needed break from studies.
* Gymkhana: There is a sprawling gymkhana ground (Marine Lines) associated with the college for sports enthusiasts.
Quick Summary Table
| Feature | Rating | Comment |
|---|---|---|
| Academics | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Excellent teaching and case variety. |
| Clinical Exposure | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | World-class; arguably the best in Western India. |
| Infrastructure | ⭐⭐⭐ | Heritage buildings, but needs modernization. |
| Hostels | ⭐⭐ | Often crowded; needs renovation. |
| Fees | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ | Very economical (Govt. rates). |
Final Verdict
Grant Government Medical College is an excellent choice for students who prioritize clinical learning and hands-on experience over luxury infrastructure.
If you are willing to work hard and adjust to a heritage campus environment, this college will mold you into a highly competent doctor. It is ideal for those who want the "real" medical experience in the heart of Mumbai.
